title: 05-thesis.json
description: The rank node's output: the screened candidates, every screener verdict, the code rank and the locked candidate. allocate, author and the check-in read it; 05-thesis.md is rendered from it.

verdicts.description: Every screener verdict, three per candidate and per re-screen; each names its candidate in item.

rank.description: Eligible candidate ids, best first, as rank.py orders them.

locked.description: rank[0]; null when no candidate is eligible (rank.py exit 3).
